title: Direct Flow Q-Learning
claim: Backpropagating through every iterative step causes gradient explosion at early steps; injecting terminal gradients directly into each step keeps gradients bounded.
layout: Single panel, top-to-bottom: BPTT chain, gradient bar chart, direct chain; red threshold lines
description: A single vertically stacked diagram. The top row shows a chain of gray circular nodes a_0, a_1, ..., a_{K-1}, a_K joined by black arrows, ending in a blue box labeled ∇_{a_K}Q. Orange curved arrows loop backward along the chain, labeled 'BPTT'. In the middle is a bar chart on a 'Max Grad' axis, with one bar per step index k. Orange bars are tallest at early steps (0, 1) and shrink toward K. The tops of the early bars cross a red dashed threshold line and turn red, labeled 'Gradient Explosion'. Small green bars under the axis mark each step index. The bottom row repeats the same chain, with green curved arrows going straight from the Q-gradient box to every node, labeled 'Direct'. The eye goes first to the tall red bars.
caption: Flow-matching-based offline RL suffers from BPTT
abstract: Flow Matching shows great promise in offline reinforcement learning (RL), yet optimizing these iterative policies via Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT) is unstable. While prevailing paradigms circumvent this by distilling multi-step flows into single-step approximations, such methods may limit the benefits of iterative refinement. To avoid these sacrifices, we propose Direct Flow Q-Learning (DFQL), a streamlined framework that attains superior results by optimizing flow matching policies without BPTT or distillation. DFQL derives a surrogate objective that directly injects terminal Q-value gradients as a guidance term into each step velocity field, ensuring stable optimization while preserving iterative expressive capacity. Across 73 challenging tasks in OGBench and D4RL, DFQL achieves state-of-the-art results. Additionally, DFQL extends seamlessly to the offline-to-online setting, delivering substantial performance gains without further modification.
